//: lean -- the APPLIANCE artifact: `./build_it_please.sh --profile lean`.
`homepage` minus the ability to reflect on itself. It runs the same world, from the same
pre-compiled image, but ships NO class source text: no `js/coffeescript-sources/` at all, which
is ~40% of a production tree, and no in-world inspectors to read it (`meta-tools` is dropped --
the build REFUSES that part together with sources "none", because inspectors with no ingested
member maps would open onto nothing).
⚠ WHAT THIS ARTIFACT CANNOT DO, stated plainly because it is a real loss and not a free win:
- no InspectorWdgt / ClassInspectorWdgt / ConsoleWdgt, so no live editing of the system
- a loaded snapshot's CLASS-scope and MIXIN-scope source edits cannot be replayed, and are
refused with one clear report rather than silently dropped (SourceEditsRegistry). Per-widget
`{"$src"}` function edits are UNAFFECTED -- those only need the compiler, which every
profile ships (arc 5 PR-D3).
- NO 'app-kit', which is the shared base layer the app parts derive from -- the app protocol
WindowedApp, the toolbar/creator-button family and their two mixins. That
is the CONSEQUENCE of the two lines below rather than a separate loss: this profile ships no
part that derives from it, so the layer would be code with nothing built on it. ⚠ It is also
the reason nothing here draws a Maker or an Examples icon -- createDesktop asks
canEverProvideClass per icon and every app class lives in a part this profile does not name.
- NO SPREADSHEET, and an EMPTY Examples folder. Neither 'spreadsheet' (the grid) nor any of
the five 'example-*' door parts is named, so the folder still opens and is still empty,
exactly as before, and a snapshot naming a sheet is refused. Naming NEITHER half is the
deliberate part: a door without its app is an icon whose only possible outcome is a rejected
load. ⚠ The folder is CORE and opens regardless; createDesktop asks canEverProvideClass per
icon, so on this profile it simply draws none of them rather than five dead ones.
What it keeps: the CoffeeScript compiler, because runtime compilation is product behaviour, not
a dev affordance -- FizzyPaint tools and per-widget `{"$src"}` records are compiled from source
strings at runtime HERE, and in the profiles that ship them so are spreadsheet formulas
(including reloading a saved sheet) and Fizzytiles' LiveCodeLang. A compiler-less artifact is a
non-interactive kiosk and is out of scope for this arc.
